title: Yarn immutable installs disabled
description: .yarnrc.yml declares an `enableImmutableInstalls=false` setting. A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads an `enableImmutableInstalls=false` setting.
remediation: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix an `enableImmutableInstalls=false` setting.
limitation: It matches an `enableImmutableInstalls=false` setting in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
